keyboard_avoidance.wiring: One KeyboardAvoidingView wraps ChatHeader, tabs/session chrome, ChatContent transcript, send-error card, and ChatComposer.
keyboard_avoidance.behavior: padding on iOS; height on other platforms
keyboard_avoidance.problem: The iOS top safe-area inset does not represent the rendered Appbar/header height, so including the header in the avoided region shifts and clips the independently useful transcript/composer area.

composer.problem: Once the controlled height reaches 110px, scrolling remains disabled, making longer draft content and the caret unreachable.
